name: Settings
description: One row: the brand being tracked, the shopping agents to check, the check cadence, and which fix types always need a person.

label.en: Set up the brand and agents to check
label.zh-CN: 设置品牌和要检查的智能体

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the settings row with the brand, the shopping agents to check, the cadence and the review policy I describe.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后按我的描述更新设置：品牌、要检查的购物智能体、检查频率和审核规则。

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then explain in plain words which fixes need a person before they are applied under the current review policy.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后用大白话解释，按当前审核规则，哪些修改必须有人批准才能执行。
